written_by: Claude (2 sample pages per sage.com market, 25 s wait after consent, full third-party capture; AT and ciel.com automated)
summary:
No Tealium or GTM publish since 19 Nov. The setup is unchanged, and the DE fix for Floodlight 98 (web-shop trials and purchases) still works.
DE stays red because of Microsoft UET. Today it sends nothing on either sample page, the Intacct page included: bat.js loads, but window.uetq stays a queue (35 / 10 events), so there is no page view and no _uetmsclkid. On 19 Nov Intacct still sent UET on a second try. UET now looks broken across DE, not just on Sage Active.
Also in DE: Quantcast sent no hit on either page within 25 s. It worked on 19 Nov and works in ES and PT today, so watch it before escalating.
FR and ES: web-shop purchases still do not fire Floodlight (129 / 36). This is the pending EU web-shop set-up. The same rule change as in DE would fix it.
FR, ES and PT sample pages are otherwise clean: the banner works, nothing fires before consent, Floodlight, Google Ads, GA4, LinkedIn, Meta and Quantcast fire, and gclid and fbclid are stored. PT is green.
Still open: AT form conversion sage_012 (GTM trigger needs a button ID), and www.ciel.com has no cookie banner.

TAG:microsoft_uet|de-produkte-sage-activ.text: After 'Accept all' bat.bing.com/bat.js loads, but window.uetq is still a plain array of 35 queued events after 25 s, so the UET library never initialises and no bat.bing.com/action hit is sent. Same since 18 Nov; no Tealium publish since 19 Nov. Worked on 16 Nov.

CLID-02|de-produkte-sage-active.text: Same cause as the UET finding: without a UET hit the _uetmsclkid cookie is never written, so Microsoft Ads clicks cannot be matched to conversions.

TAG:microsoft_uet|de-cp-sage-intacct.text: Same picture today (window.uetq stays a queue of 10 events, no hit). On 19 Nov this page sent UET via its own tag 12002546 on the second try, so UET on Intacct is at best unreliable. Together with Sage Active and payroll this points to a general UET problem in de-de, e.g. the UET consent hand-over or the bat.js initialisation.

CLID-02|de-cp-sage-intacct.text: Same cause as the UET finding on this page.

TAG:quantcast|de-produkte-sage-active.text: No request to pixel.quantserve.com within 25 s after consent on either DE page. On 19 Nov the Quantcast pixel (p-E6KY6asqFcmVm) fired about 3 s after consent, and today it fires in ES and PT. No publish in between, so this may be intermittent. Re-check on the next run before escalating.

FORM-02|form:HCM_2701_NCA_DE_HRReadyNCAB.text: The form's lastContentName starts with a space (' CL_HCM_DE_MED_CON_BOFU_HRReadyNCABeratung'). Load rule 331 checks the start of the name, so Floodlight 389 never fires for this form. Fix: remove the space in the Gated Content gate.

GTM-07|conversion:sage_012.text: GTM-PS6MXC v13 (unchanged): sageg0/sage_012 fires on gtm.click where Click ID contains 'Submit'. The submit inputs on /kontaktformular/ and /kostenloses-infopaket/ have no id, so the trigger never matches. Fix: trigger on the form's success event or thank-you page, or give the buttons an id containing 'Submit'.

GTM-07|conversion:sage_013.text: sageg0/sage_013 fires on a click on a link to uploads/SageDPWtoGO_Bestellformular_neu_3503_DE.pdf. None of the paid landing pages or form pages link to it. Check whether the PDF is still offered; if not, the tag is obsolete.
